photos.subject: Bitexco Financial Tower, Ho Chi Minh City
photos.fun_fact: Its 250-ton helipad was manufactured in South Korea and required road closures to hoist into place.

photos.subject: Eiffel Tower, Paris
photos.fun_fact: Built in 1889, it was the world's tallest structure for 41 years until the Chrysler Building surpassed it.

photos.subject: Beijing National Stadium
photos.fun_fact: The interwoven steel beams were inspired by Chinese ceramics and give the structure its 'Bird's Nest' nickname.

photos.subject: Empire State Building, New York
photos.fun_fact: It has its own ZIP code (10118), one of only 43 New York City buildings with their own postal code.
